desc: Define the 4 diagonal directions (dr,dc) = (1,1),(1,-1),(-1,-1),(-1,1) in clockwise order, and the expected value function: step k from start (k=0) expects 1 if k==0 else (2 if k odd else 0).
Design DP1 (no turn) and DP2 (one clockwise turn) recurrences with parity-aware lengths.
Implement `lenOfVDiagonal`: per-direction sweeps with dp0/dp1 states, start/straight/turn transitions, global max tracking.

Verify turn parity handling and test against all four examples (5, 4, 5, 1) plus edge cases: no 1 in grid, single row/column, all 1s diagonal, and opposite-parity-prefix extension case (determine if per-parity states are required; if a counterexample fails, fix DP to store best length per parity).
Check performance: confirm O(16·n·m) time runs within limits for n,m ≤ 500 in Python; optimize loops/memory if needed.
